title: TFMG Plastic Casting Fix
description: This small datapack fixes broken Plastic Casting recipe from The Factory Must Grow
body: This small datapack fixes broken Plastic Casting recipe from The Factory Must Grow. The original recipe requires 200mb of Molten Plastic but the Casting Basin only has capacity of 144mb thus making the Plastic Sheet uncraftable. This datapack changes the requirement from 200mb to 144mb to make the recipe work correctly and to match similar Casting Basin recipes.
